component: MailNews StringFields and exclusion preference parsing

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The delimiter predicate contains SPACE, TAB, LF, FF and CR. It skips runs of those bytes and returns nonempty nsCString fields. Vertical tab and non-ASCII whitespace are not delimiters in this implementation, despite the broad ASCII-whitespace wording in the declaration comment. The new test directly compares eight literal input/output cases, including multibyte words, and its one assertion omits an explicit behavior message. No delimiter or GTest execution was performed; this is a scoped implementation/test limit, not a new global whitespace rule.
title: StringFields uses five explicit ASCII delimiter bytes
